title: Exclusive service-bay supported two-arm relay with measured link exclusion
instruction: Transfer the blue inspection component from the left source to the green receiver target, using both arms and the black shared handoff support. The handoff bay is exclusive: the receiving arm must not enter until the component is stably supported and the releasing arm has cleared the bay. Avoid disturbing the amber service fixture. Finish with the component released and supported at the target.
context: A dual-arm equipment-service cell must exchange small parts around a rigid inspection fixture. Uncoordinated arm entry can cause arm–arm interference and disturbance of equipment under service. The keepout body models equipment segregation, not a person or a certified safety interlock.
setup: YAM station (table top z=0.7475 m); two 6-DOF fixed-base arms at x=0, y=+/-0.305 m, parallel fingers. Blue rigid 40x40x40 mm component, mass 50 g, center (0.160,0.150,0.7685) m; black rigid fixed handoff support 100x95x10 mm, center (0.300,0.040,0.7525) m; green rigid fixed target pad 100x100x1 mm, center (0.200,-0.200,0.748) m; amber solid rigid service fixture 80x80x660 mm, 400 g, center (0.082,0,1.0775) m. Uses the installed YAM/Isaac material/contact defaults; friction values are not independently calibrated. Transparent rendering changes no collider.
scoring: Official 0.0/0.5/1.0 callback: 0.5 after a genuine first lift and 0.30 s stable supported set-down on the transfer pad; 1.0 after a second lift and stable final placement. Any observed arm-link violation of the 4-mm protected-fixture geometric clearance, inter-arm collider overlap, simultaneous exclusive-bay occupancy, premature receiving-arm entry or wrong-side tool entry permanently scores 0. All 18 YAM rigid-body poses are read at 20 Hz directly from PhysX/Torch tensors; unavailable states fail closed. No calibrated contact-force measurement is claimed.
run_limit: 1,100 actions at 20 Hz (55 s); seed 42 reference, jitter 0; one trial per simulator process.
reset_notes: Start one trial in a new simulator/task process; reinitialize arm-safety latch and object scorer on each new task module load.
fidelity: GPU Isaac/YAM rigid simulation with conservative local capsules derived from the installed YAM USD collision geometry. Per-step Torch tensor rigid-body poses (all 9 links per arm), geometric clearance and shared-bay exclusion are scored in the official callback. Control-rate 20-Hz checks may miss faster transient contact; force impulses and human presence are not modeled. The amber object represents equipment segregation, not an actual person or ISO-certified interlock.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0/1.0 (1,100 actions; seed 42). Scripted two-arm reference: 1.0/1.0 (seed 42). Negative controls: inter-arm overlap 0.0, protected-fixture intrusion 0.0, stage-only 0.5. All scores are from the final v6.5 official scorer.
